about: Every Kitchen physics journey of scripts/production-simulation and scripts/bakery-robots (Refactor 16, step 14). run-journeys.mjs runs them, and its --check (pnpm lint:journey-index) refuses a journey file with no row. Tiers: fast runs in less than 300 s, slow takes 300 s or more or a large heap, browser needs a Portal page. lastRun is the last measured time on one Mac; a journey that does not pass gives failure.reason and failure.proof. The set ci is the headless part of the bakery-physics CI job, in its order.

journeys.notes: The step 11 runtime prepares the two cells, so that file-execution saves under the step 11 execution bundle and resumes on the pinned one. Change the runtime at each engine release.

Release A is the execution bundle of the step 11 runtime that steps 12 to 15A pin; release B adds the pinned execution bundle (step 9). The journey needs a different engine file in B. Change both at each engine release. The step 11 bundles are outside git after the move of step 9B: fetch them first (node scripts/repo-binaries.mjs fetch apps/portal/public/bakery-physics).

Needs MUJOCO_DIR (it builds the arm_asset_acceptance example). It rewrites the committed files in assets/bakery-robots/<robot>/acceptance; on 2026-11-17 they differed only near 1e-14, and the run restored them.
Needs MUJOCO_DIR, because it runs cargo build.
